observations: All 25 standalone diagram PNGs and all fifteen document PNGs were personally viewed through view_image with detail original. There is no standalone layout PNG in the producer inventory.

All source images are at most 4000 pixels high. No derived strip or new asset was needed. The complete document capture is 1440 by 56122 pixels, represented by fourteen 4000-pixel-high contiguous source rectangles and one 122-pixel-high final rectangle.

Diagram labels, long Latin exception identifiers, numeric branches, terminal nodes and connection arrowheads were visible without word-fragment wrapping, opaque label overlap or figure-boundary clipping.
Document prose, tables, code blocks and link labels were readable throughout. No embedded CSS overlay, hidden body text, clipped cell glyph or missing figure edge was observed.

Capture boundaries sometimes cross a table or flow image. Every contiguous capture was viewed and each of the 25 figures was also viewed whole in its standalone original; the boundary continuation does not omit source pixels.

The review concerns source-render geometry and visible completeness only. It does not execute application logic or endorse business semantics, source fidelity, official percentages, all61 completion, PDF/Excel print quality, final adoption, or publication.
